liebermann.description_de: Die l und Quadr. gemeinsame verlorene Vorlage; „Das Ld und Quadr. Gemeinsame nenne ich lq“ (I 147 Anm. *)
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: his siglum for the readings Ld and the Quadripartitus share, which he also treats as their lost common source. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.laws: Af, Ine, AGu, EGu, I Ew, II Ew, I As, As Alm, II As, V As, I Em, II Em, II Eg, III Eg, II Atr, Duns, Geþyncðo, Norðleod, Mirce, Að
liebermann.notes: Posited by Liebermann. In a footnote to I As Prol. (Gesetze I, p. 147, note *) he explains: “What Ld and Quadr. have in common I call lq.” So in his German translation, words in round brackets followed by lq, e.g. “(meines lq)”, are words found in both Ld and Quadr. but not in the other manuscripts; and in his notes, “lq’s reading” is the reading the two share. In his introduction (pp. xxiv, xxxiv) he goes further and treats lq as a lost collection (“Sammelband”) from which both Lambarde’s source l and the Quadripartitus drew, for Alfred–Ine, AGu, I–II Edward, I and V Æthelstan, Æthelstan’s Alms ordinance, II–III Edgar, II Æthelred, Dunsæte, Norðleod, Mirce and Að; on this site it is also cited in his notes to EGu, II As, I–II Em and Geþyncðo.

entries.text_en: The lost exemplar common to l and Quadr. for Af-Ine11, AGu, I. II Ew, I As, As Alm, V As, II. III Eg, II Atr, Duns, Norðleod, Mirce, Að.

notes.text_en: cf. previous page, notes4—14; my Quadripartitus p. 46.

others.text: Sisam showed (and Wormald 1999, p. 261, accepts) that Lambarde’s texts of I As, As Alm, Norðleod, Mirce and Að are “translations of the Quadripartitus into Elizabethan Anglo-Saxon”: there Ld agrees with Quadr. because it was translated from it.
On Lambarde’s sources generally, see l. Cf. hlq.

(Gesetze I, p. 147, note *) he explains: “What Ld and Quadr. have in common I call lq.” So in his German translation, words in round brackets followed by lq, e.g. “(meines lq)”, are words found in both Ld and Quadr. but not in the other manuscripts; and in his notes, “lq’s reading” is the reading the two share.
